name: Navigation
description: The main links of a site or app in a bar, with dropdowns; a sheet on narrow screens.

items.description: The bar's items in order; an item repeating an earlier value is dropped.

value.description: Value of the current page's item, marked `aria-current="page"`; `null` marks none, and an unknown value marks none.

defaultValue.description: Current item on mount when `value` is not set; read once.

surface.description: `inline` shows the bar; `sheet` shows a trigger that opens the items in a bottom sheet; `auto` is a sheet below 900px.

open.description: Whether the sheet is open; only a sheet surface opens, and leaving it closes an uncontrolled sheet.

defaultOpen.description: Whether the sheet is open on mount when `open` is not set; read once.

trigger.description: Element that opens the sheet, keeping its own props; text renders as a Button. Default: an icon button named `labels.open`.

aria-label.description: Names the navigation landmark (default "Main") and titles the sheet.

labels.description: Strings Navigation renders itself: `open` names the default sheet trigger, `close` the sheet's close button.

behavior.pattern: APG disclosure navigation: links and disclosure buttons, no menu roles.
behavior.dropdowns: One open at a time; a click toggles, hover opens after 200 ms and closes 150 ms after leaving; focus leaving the item, Escape and an outside press close it.
behavior.autoFocusOnOpen: ArrowDown/ArrowUp on a trigger: the first or last link; click or hover: none
behavior.sheet: Below 900px with surface auto: a trigger opens the items in a modal bottom sheet; activating a link closes it.

Tab.condition: every enabled item and every link of the open dropdown is in the tab sequence

notes: The root is a <nav> landmark; aria-label names it when a page has several.
The current page's link has aria-current="page"; dropdown triggers are buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
The dropdown surface is a Card surface; the compact sheet is a Modal at the bottom edge.

whenToUse: Primary site or app navigation in a header
Top-level sections with dropdowns of links
whenNotToUse: Content switching within a page (use Tabs)
